title: salvia compar
intro: Salvia compar, commonly known as Sage, is a perennial herb belonging to the Lamiaceae family, native to the Mediterranean region and parts of Asia and Europe. It has been used for centuries in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to improve cognitive function, memory, and mood, as well as its potential to lower cholesterol and blood pressure levels. The therapeutic actions of Sage include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as ursolic acid, rosmarinic acid, and carnosic acid. These constituents have been shown to have neuroprotective, anti-aging, and anti-cancer properties, making Sage a popular herb in modern herbalism and medicine.
